name: Pou Sheng International (Holdings) Limited
summary: Pou Sheng International (Holdings) Limited, founded in 1992 and based in Kwun Tong, Hong Kong, is an investment holding company that distributes and retails sportswear and footwear in China and elsewhere. It also leases commercial space to retailers and distributors for concession sales and provides sports event organization, sports marketing and technical advisory services. It is a subsidiary of Major Focus Management Limited.
